name: Archie Overlooker (staff loop and filing tripwires, duplicate-ticket scan, weekly staff report)

knobs.note: BH-5562: 0 stops the run before any roster read. Read by bin/archie-overlook.sh as ${ARCHIE_OVERLOOK_ENABLED:-1}; out of range is one warn line in logs/archie-overlook.log and the default.
BH-5562: the loop wire. One staff agent with this many acted files of one class slug in one UTC day gets flags/staff-off-<agent> and one warn beat.
BH-5562: the filing wire. One staff agent with this many `filed` acted files in one UTC day gets flags/staff-off-<agent> and one warn beat.
BH-5562: the UTC weekday (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday) of the weekly staff report, sent once per ISO week through Archie's beat gate.
BH-5562: owner/repo the staff agents file into (the staff lane's knob, read here for the duplicate scan and precision). NOT settable from the control plane; set it in env/global.env.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-overlook.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-overlook.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/archie-overlook.sh honours ARCHIE_NOW and sources ARCHIE_OVERLOOK_FIXTURE only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
